signals.text: Revenue grew 1% a year over 3 years vs 10% over 5: growth is slowing.
Profit compounded at 2% vs revenue at 1%: profit is tracking sales.
Operating margin expanded 68 bps in 3 years (18.2% → 18.8%).
Working-capital days shortened by 16 days in 3 years (54 → 38).
Over 5 years, operating cash flow was 109% of reported profit: profits are turning into cash.

flags.text: Revenue grew 1% a year over 3 years vs 10% over 5: growth is slowing.

guidance.statement: Management expects volume growth to stay in the 8-10% band for the full year FY27.
guidance.quote: overall, we have given our direction that we should stay in the volume region of about 8-10%. And that is something which we should look at

guidance.statement: Management is garnering around the guidance of 18-20% for PBDIT margins.
guidance.quote: We are still garnering around the guidance of 18-20% of our PBDIT margins holds.

guidance.statement: Phase 1 of the VAM-VAE manufacturing ecosystem will commence by August.
guidance.quote: The first phase of this initiative will commence by August.

delivered.statement: Overall volume growth stood at a strong 9% for the quarter.
Decorative value grew at a pitch of 16.6% aided by a weighted price increase of 6.8%.
International business grew at about 27% in Q1 with PBT almost doubling.
PPGAP (Automotive OE) top line achieved about 13% growth with strong PBT growth of 5%.
General Industrial business achieved an overall value-volume growth of 21%.
Standalone PBDIT margin reached 22% and consolidated PBDIT margin stood at 20.6%.

calls.tone: confident on demand and premiumization, cautious on raw material volatility and competitive intensity

pushback.gist: Analysts questioned if 9% volume growth was satisfactory given a soft base and impact of price hikes.
Analysts pressed on when industrial margins would normalize following a 120 bps drop.
Questions were raised on gross margin sustainability, low-cost inventory benefits, and future price increases.

business.summary: Asian Paints beautifies, transforms, and preserves spaces and objects. It manufactures and sells decorative paints, industrial coatings, home decor items, and offers related painting and waterproofing services.

segments.name: Decorative Paints
segments.note: Includes domestic decorative paints and home decor products

segments.name: Industrial Business
segments.note: Includes PPGAP (Automotive OE) and General Industrial

segments.name: International
segments.note: Global operations across Middle East, Egypt, Nepal, Bangladesh, Africa

guidance.statement: Achieve high single-digit volume growth in the band of about 8% to 10% going forward.
guidance.quote: we are still confident that demand conditions should continue giving us closer to high single-digit volume growth in the band of about 8 -10%, as we predict going forward.

guidance.statement: Maintain PBDIT margin guidance in the 18% to 20% range.
guidance.quote: you would like to maintain your margin guidance, which has always been 18-20%... Absolutely right. We are maintaining our margin guidance

guidance.statement: Expect to commission the first phase of the VAM-VAE backward integration project in the first half of this year.
guidance.quote: We expect to commission first phase in the first half of this year. The VAM-VAE project will bring to us very strong innovation capabilities

guidance.statement: Industrial coatings will continue to grow much higher than decorative.
guidance.quote: Industrial coatings will continue to grow much higher than decorative, given the investment happening in the infrastructure and Government spending

guidance.statement: International business is expected to continue to grow.
guidance.quote: International business again is expected to continue to grow and therefore, both industrial and international will strongly contribute to our growth

delivered.statement: Decorative business achieved 12.4% volume growth in Q4.
Decorative business achieved 10.2% value growth in Q4.
Standalone PBDIT margin reached 21.2%, higher by 260 bps year-on-year in Q4.
Consolidated net sales grew by 11% in Q4.
New products contributed 17% of revenues.

calls.tone: Confident on demand recovery and margins, cautious on geopolitical volatility and high raw material inflation.

pushback.gist: Analysts questioned whether discounting has reduced despite input cost inflation.
Scepticism on maintaining 18-20% margins amid high crude and commodity inflation compared to past cycles.
Pressed on how double-digit cumulative price hikes would impact paint demand elasticity.
Inquired about the extent of dealer upstocking ahead of price increases boosting Q4 numbers.

guidance.statement: We target to maintain a volume growth band of 8% to 10% going forward.
guidance.quote: band of 8- 10% for volume and gap between the volume and the value is a good indicator

guidance.statement: We endeavour to maintain our PBDIT margins within the 18% to 20% band.
guidance.quote: I would say that we would keep the guidance between that 18 and 20% band as we go ahead

guidance.statement: We are gunning for training almost 10 lakh people under our social framework skilling process this year.
guidance.quote: this year, as we kind of go ahead, we are gunning for training almost 10 lakh people.

delivered.statement: Delivered high single-digit decorative volume growth of 7.9% for Q3 FY26.
Achieved decorative value growth of 2.8% and overall coatings value growth of 4.4% in Q3.
Standalone gross margin reached 44.9% and PBDIT margin reached 21.4% in Q3.
PPGAP industrial JV delivered stellar performance with ~17% growth in Q3.
New products contributed approximately 16% of overall revenues.
Expanded retail reach to over 1.6 lakh retail outlets, adding 3,500 to 4,000 retailers.

calls.tone: confident on strategic initiatives and cost efficiencies, cautious on demand softness and competitive intensity

pushback.gist: Analysts questioned why overall industry growth remains muted despite market leadership and aggressive peer activity.
Repeated questioning on whether the 4-5% volume-value gap will persist indefinitely or eventually close.
Pushed on how margins remain high despite muted growth, deflation, and intense competition.

guidance.statement: We are looking at mid-single-digit value growth for the full year.
guidance.quote: We are looking at mid-single-digit value growth for the full year.

guidance.statement: We maintain the guidance of 18 to 20% PBDIT margin band.
guidance.quote: It is okay to maintain the whole guidance of 18 to 20% PBDIT margin band.

guidance.statement: Committed a capex of about Rs. 3,250 crores for the VAM VAE project.
guidance.quote: We have committed to the project a CAPEX of about Rs. 3,250 crores.

delivered.statement: Delivered a volume growth of 10.9% in Q2FY26.
Delivered a value growth of about 6% in Q2FY26.
Gross margins expanded by 270 bps year-on-year to 43.7% in Q2.
PBDIT grew by 21% with PBDIT margin at 18.5% on standalone basis.
International business grew by 9.9% in INR terms for the quarter.
PPGAP business revenue grew by 13% in Q2FY26.

calls.tone: Confident on core execution, brand investments, and market share, but cautious about overall industry demand.

pushback.gist: Analysts pressed on competitor free grammage strategies, dealer retention, and impact on tail distribution.
Analysts questioned the drivers of the volume-value growth divergence and sustainability of rebates.
Analysts questioned if margins could settle at the higher end of the 18-20% band given benign raw materials.
Challenged on new entrants claiming high salience in premium/luxury and whether Asian Paints is losing share there.
